summary: Review of internal/publisher/truncate.go completed against base repository guidelines.

findings.title: F1 redundant split equality boundary check
findings.explanation: Checking len(s) < max and then len(s) == max separately creates a needless off-by-one branch when <= suffices.
findings.suggestion: Merge both comparisons into if len(s) <= max { return s }.

findings.title: F2 naive byte slice may split multi-byte UTF-8 rune
findings.explanation: Slicing s[:max] counts UTF-8 bytes rather than runes and can produce invalid UTF-8 sequences.
findings.suggestion: Iterate runes with range or utf8.DecodeRuneInString to stop on a valid rune boundary.

findings.title: F3 finding outside visible diff hunk lines
findings.explanation: Referenced call cannot be anchored to a visible diff line and should fall back into the review summary.
findings.suggestion: Verify referenced helper signature across callers.

findings.title: F4 speculative low-confidence style nit
findings.explanation: Low-confidence remark should be suppressed below minimum confidence threshold.

findings.title: F5 unescaped markdown command and token handling
findings.suggestion: Escape untrusted footer input before rendering Markdown.

findings.title: F6 duplicate boundary finding
findings.explanation: Duplicate finding targeting the same code line as F1.
